correctness.rationale: For each \(z>0\) and \(n\ge3\) the symmetric three-state transfer matrix has Perron eigenvalue Lambda and subleading eigenvalues \(-z/\Lambda\) and \(-z\). The Perron-state correlation functions split into even and odd rail modes with variance \(m(1-m)/2\) and \(m/2\), correlation ratios \(-r(1-r)/(1+r)\) and \(-r\), respectively; absolutely summable two-point series give the two displayed positive Fourier multipliers. A finite-ring transfer trace expansion converges uniformly in Fourier k to these multipliers as n tends to infinity at fixed z. Exact factorization of the four endpoint values yields a strictly larger antisymmetric alternating maximum, and the zero-frequency minimum changes rail parity exactly when \(1-3r^2\) changes sign. The z-transform gives one threshold \(1+2/\sqrt3\); division gives exact piecewise sharp kappa and asymptotics. Each finite Gram is positive definite by empty/singleton support. Exact symbolic simplification, \(3^n\) weighted finite enumeration for \(3\le n\le9\) and numerical convergence checks through \(n=128\) independently support but do not substitute for the proof; no finite check is offered as an infinite certificate. Direct differentiation of the two verified rational branches also establishes a positive activity-derivative jump of \(9(\sqrt3-1)/4\); this identity is checked symbolically.

value.rationale: The natural observation problem is reconstructing first-coordinate Fourier data from the grand-canonical hard-core ensemble of a cyclic two-rail graph. Uniform-activity data alone leave the physically motivated activity dependence unresolved. The exact bulk two-branch mode structure identifies which spatial/rail modes lose observability first, proves a unique transverse rail-parity switch at an explicit nontrivial fugacity, and quantifies the sharp high-density quadratic deterioration of inversion stability; these are structural exact invariants across an infinite parameter family rather than a finite numerical gain or a new label for the known partition function. No general scientific downstream theorem is claimed. Its piecewise limit has a sharp, exactly calculated corner with slope jump \(9(\sqrt3-1)/4\), making the reconstruction bottleneck switch quantitatively observable.
